text: This repo is a tool factory. It holds two kinds of parts, atoms and tools. An atom is one building block that does one job, such as download, transcribe, or digest. A tool is something Victor uses, such as the YouTube tool. Tools call atoms through their command line, and never call other tools. Atoms import the shared kit, and never import each other.
